Samuel turns to the Lord in grief.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Trust Samuel to seek God's word

Let God choose His king.

Wait with him in silence.

warning.title: [TODO:ru] The Cost of a King
warning.text:
[TODO:ru] "He will take your sons and fields."
The people still cry for one.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] His words are for you too.

shout_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Quiet Your Voice
shout_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Listen before you answer.
The prophet speaks for God.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You let his words sink deep.

walk_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Stay and Hear
walk_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] These words will shape your life.
Return and listen.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You step back to the circle.

lost_path.title: [TODO:ru] Father's Donkeys Are Lost
lost_path.text:
[TODO:ru] Days of searching, hills of dust.
A servant says, "There is a seer here."

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Pay him only for the donkeys

giveup_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Press Onward
giveup_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Your search is more than donkeys.
Go to the seer.

pay_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Greater Than Coin
pay_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] He has no need of your silver.
Go and hear his word.

anointing.title: [TODO:ru] Oil on Your Head
anointing.text:
[TODO:ru] Samuel pours oil and kisses you.
"The Lord has chosen you to lead."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] A king kneels before God first.
[TODO:ru] Do not refuse what God gives.
[TODO:ru] The oil runs warm down your brow.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Bow First
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] The crown is heavy with calling.
Receive it in humility.

reject_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Do Not Refuse
reject_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] God Himself anoints through Samuel.
Receive what is given.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your hands rest open at your side.

assembly.title: [TODO:ru] Tribes Gather at Mizpah
assembly.text:
[TODO:ru] Lots fall and your name is called.
The people search the camp.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] God will still bring you out.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Serve First
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] A king of Israel serves the Lord.
Step forward humbly.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Found Among the Jars
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] They draw you out into the light.
Your calling cannot be hidden.

confirmation.title: [TODO:ru] "Long Live the King!"
confirmation.text:
[TODO:ru] The tribes shout and bow before you.
A new road opens at your feet.
